evidence.quote: About Tongyan Lin Welcome! I am an Associate Professor at the Department of Physics at UCSD. I work on theoretical particle physics, particle astrophysics, and cosmology, and I am part of the High Energy Theory group at UCSD. Prior to joining UCSD, I was a postdoctoral fellow at Lawrence Berkeley National Lab and UC Berkeley, and a KICP fellow at the University of Chicago. I received my PhD in Physics from Harvard University and undergraduate degree from MIT. Contact info: Mayer Hall 5210 UC San Diego 9500 Gilman Dr. La Jolla, CA 92093 tongyan@physics.ucsd.edu OR tol057@ucsd.edu
I am an Associate Professor at the Department of Physics at UCSD.
My research is at the interface of theoretical particle physics, cosmology, and particle astrophysics. A central theme of my work is understanding the particle physics of dark matter .

I am interested in identifying new experimental and observational probes that can test the underlying theory of dark matter. More broadly, I am interested in the phenomenology of dark (or hidden) sectors, theoretical connections to other unresolved puzzles within the standard model, as well as early universe cosmology.
